lines.zh: 我把斧子扛在肩上，跳过水沟。
lines.en: Axe on my shoulder, I hop the ditch.
Each step packs the mud down.

lines.zh: 我走得很直，冲着村门去。
lines.en: I walk straight at the village gate.

lines.zh: 斧刃擦着芦苇，割断一排。
lines.en: The blade skims the reeds, cutting a row.
Water to my shins, and I keep walking.

lines.zh: 芦苇在我膝下折成两排。
lines.en: The reeds fold in two rows beneath my knees.

lines.zh: 身上的疙瘩在夜色里发亮。
lines.en: The bumps on my hide shine in the dark.

lines.zh: 我拖着斧柄，划出一道沟。
lines.en: I drag the haft and leave a groove.
My foot slipped. I caught myself.
I head for the gap in the wall.
One stride over the broken fence.
I don't go around. Straight through.

lines.zh: 喉咙里咕噜一声，我加快了。
lines.en: A low croak, and I move faster.

lines.zh: 我在算到门口还有几步。
lines.en: I'm counting the steps to the gate.
I stand with the axe planted in the mud.

lines.zh: 斧柄缠的布，被泥水泡软了。
lines.en: The cloth around my axe handle is soaked soft by the mud.

lines.zh: 我把斧刃在腿上蹭了蹭。
lines.en: I wipe the blade against my leg.
Dogs are barking in the village.
A body this big can't hide.
And I don't want to.

lines.zh: 我盯着木门，看它厚不厚。
lines.en: I stare at the wooden gate, judging its thickness.
I tap my fingers on the haft.
Water runs off my arms.

lines.zh: 我把斧子提起来，又放下。
lines.en: I lift the axe, then set it down again.
The night wind is just right.
I'm waiting for the others.
The axe isn't heavy.
I lick my lips. Nothing.
Standing at the gate — blocking me?

lines.zh: 我举了举斧子，算是打招呼。
lines.en: I lift the axe. Call it a greeting.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，挡不住这斧。
lines.en: What you're holding won't stop this axe.

lines.zh: 我不用跑，我走过去就行。
lines.en: I don't need to run. Walking will do.
Guarding these frogs — what for?
Move. I'd rather not cut one more.

lines.zh: 你把武器放下，我走得快点。
lines.en: Drop the weapon and I'll pass quicker.
I crack my neck to one side.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在雾里，你看不清。
lines.en: My eyes in the fog — you can't see them.

lines.zh: 你的手在往背后摸什么？
lines.en: What is that hand of yours reaching for behind you?
Such a small frame.

lines.zh: 别站在我斧子的另一边。
lines.en: Don't stand on the far side of my axe.
How do you plan to stop me?
I rarely talk.
I've said my piece. Move.
Now. Clear the gate.

lines.zh: 这一下砍在皮上，没到骨。
lines.en: That struck hide, not bone.
I took half a step back, axe still held.
My blood is cold. It runs slowly.
I grit my teeth and push forward.
These lumps serve as armor too.
My arm is heavy. I can't raise it high.
The pain makes me want to swing more.
I crouch and take two breaths.
Don't think I can't stand.
The axe is still in my hand.
Food? After the fight.

lines.zh: 我一手接过来，一手还握着斧。
lines.en: I take it in one hand, axe in the other.

lines.zh: 沼泽里的东西，我吃得下。
lines.en: Marsh food sits fine with me.
Too little. Barely a mouthful.

lines.zh: 你放远一点，别站那么近。
lines.en: Put it further off. Don't stand so close.
Two chews and it's gone.
This will keep me going till dawn.
That taste isn't bad.
Don't stretch your hand out too far.
I'll still fight after eating.
You ran into me and bounced off.
This bulk isn't soft to hit.
Stay off me. The axe has no eyes.
Axe on my shoulder, I head for the frog village.

lines.zh: 我侧了下身，你就挤过去了。
lines.en: I turned slightly and you squeezed past.

lines.zh: 斧柄撞到你，不算我动手。
lines.en: The haft hit you. I didn't swing.
Mud is slick. I slid half a step.
Back off. I'm about to swing.
All this water makes footing hard.
Clear the way or I walk over you.
I don't talk about that.
You're a Croak too. Stand back.
After this fight. Perhaps.
We only answer to one village.
Your axe is lighter than mine.

lines.zh: 别站那么近，我出手很猝。
lines.en: Not so close. My swings come sudden.
Survive first. Then there's an after.

lines.zh: 要一起走，就跟在我后面。
lines.en: To come along, walk behind me.
I won't look back. Keep up yourself.
When this night ends, I'll see you in the water.
I lift it one-handed. Light.
I tuck it under an arm and walk on.
This could block a blow.
I stepped on it. It broke.
Yours? Catch.
I drop it in the water. Simpler.
This handle is decent.
Too heavy. I put it down.
I squeeze it. Soft.
I'll note this spot.
The one behind the gate. I see it.
I raise the axe.
No shout. Straight over.
It's standing too near the gate.
The water's shallow. Easy going.
The gatepost first.
They're all falling back.
I fix on the one in front.
My kin are wrapping round the left.
No more waiting. Go.
Step by step. I don't stop.
It raised a shield. Better still.
Five steps to the gate.
Arrows come down from the wall.
I raise the axe and turn two aside.
It's retreated inside the gate.
I follow it in.

lines.zh: 水里的东西碰到我的腿。
lines.en: Something in the water brushes my leg.
That thing in the water — I don't look at it.
A square ahead. Room to swing.
I swing the axe straight down.
The gate split.
The blade comes sideways. A different swing.
Two chops, no breath between.
The flat of my axe rings on its bracer.
I push the axe in with my weight.
This one goes for its legs.
Blood sprays across my chest.

lines.zh: 斧头拔出来，再往它腰上送。
lines.en: I wrench the axe free and swing it at its waist.
Don't just stand there. Run.
I wade out of the water.
The axe goes on my shoulder first.
In the fog, I look even bigger.
The frogs here know me.
My weight caved the muddy bank.
I look up at the wall.
The wall isn't high. That's enough.
Marsh water still on my legs.
I walk to the gate. No hurry.
The axe sits steady on my shoulder.
Fire seared my hide. Blisters.

lines.zh: 从墙上摔下来，骨头响了一声。
lines.en: I fell off the wall and a bone cracked.
My head went under and I couldn't hold it.
The blast threw me into the mud.
An arrow's in my shoulder.
That light weighs me down. Can't lift the axe.
Two days hungry. My hands are soft.
Lightning struck and I went rigid.

lines.zh: 这里没有地，我踩不下去。
lines.en: No ground here. I can't plant a foot.
